name: THS4631
tagline: A ±15 V JFET-input op-amp with 210 MHz GBW and 1000 V/µs; a Japanese cult I/V part, airy and transparent once stable.

lineage.note: Sole source. SLOS451 Dec 2004; Rev A 2005, B 2011, C 2025 ('new silicon data').

reputation.summary: A niche cult part in Japan's DIY scene, mostly for I/V after current-output DACs and in headphone amps via DIP-8 adapters. An Ameblo blog calls it 'the rumoured op-amp' (噂のオペアンプ); Shirokuma sells it pre-mounted. Users report extended highs, air and transparency when it is not oscillating. TI lists 'current DAC output buffer' as an application. No audio-band measurements known.
typical_uses: DIP-8 rolling via conversion boards (Shirokuma dual board)
Headphone amp swap (Elekit TU-HP01, per xgender-isao blog)
caveats: Oscillates easily on adapters; users add an output Zobel. TI warns large feedback resistors oscillate; use a feedback capacitor.
Runs hot: 12.5 mA typ per channel (Rev C), about 0.375 W idle at ±15 V; dual adapters carry two.
Thermal pad ambiguous: layout text says isolated (ground it), Rev C pin table says V−. Tie it to V−.
SMD single only; needs an adapter, dual-conversion board for dual sockets. Noise specified only above 10 kHz.
Parts shipped after Rev C (March 2025) may be new silicon; listening reports (c. 2018–2020) predate it.

counterfeit_notes: No specific reports. Genuine marks: '4631' on D/DDA, 'ADK' on DGN; DDA has an exposed pad. 'New' THS4631D/DGN tube stock (obsolete since 2023) is suspect. Buy authorized or Shirokuma/eleshop.jp boards. Markings cannot distinguish pre/post-2025 silicon.

silicon_changes.summary: Rev C re-characterises the part on 'new silicon data'; TI (E2E) cites a new process, advising no CF in new designs. Output current, Iq, flatness changed; headlines (7 nV/√Hz, 210 MHz, 1000 V/µs, ±500 µV, 100 pA) did not. Rev B was current in 2019; TI's 2020-11-02 model used it.
silicon_changes.identification: Datasheet only: SLOS451C (Mar 2025) vs SLOS451B (Aug 2011). Markings unchanged ('4631', 'ADK'); no date-code cutoff. PDN20230907001 (Sep 2023) only dropped tube SKUs; '.A'/'.B' suffixes prove nothing.

spec_deltas.before: 'Electrically isolated'; ground recommended; VS- to VS+ allowed
spec_deltas.after: Pin table: internally connected to V-; the layout text in the same Rev C still says isolated/ground

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Untested by listeners. Expect more idle heat, stronger drive and different response with CF; recheck Zobel and CF values tuned on old parts.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium: same pinout and AC specs, but higher Iq, changed loop response, pad potential; tie pad to V−.
silicon_changes.verification: SLOS451C and TI E2E 1514297 confirm a process change. Candidate PCN 20240826006.0 not tied to THS4631.

revision_history.changes: Related-products table changed; input impedance 10^9 || 6.5 → 10^9 || 3.9 (Ω || pF); RL→RF labels fixed; transient figures, EVM schematic added.
Tstg corrected from '65°C to 150°C' to '–65°C to 150°C'. No electrical changes.
New format; 'new silicon data': output current 180 mA typ, Iq max 14.5/15 mA, flatness 38→6 MHz. Unlisted: Iq typ 12.5 mA, pad to V−.

revision_chains.note: No copy of the original found. Rev A and B have no TI revision-pinned URL.

open_questions: Is Rev C's 'new silicon data' a die, process, fab or leadframe change? Is there a PCN and date code?
Is the DDA/DGN pad tied to V− on current parts? Rev C pin table and layout text disagree.
Rev C inconsistencies: Features 95 mA vs 180 mA typ; '−40 to +125 °C' vs 85 °C; 150 mA max.
Which revisions do Kyohritsu, Octopart, DigiKey and alldatasheet copies hold? Where is a copy of the 2004 original?
When did E4/G4 variants and DDAR become obsolete? Do Japanese adapter vendors now ship Rev C silicon?

claims_confirmed: TI symlink serves the THS4631 datasheet; no newer revision seen (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ths4631.pdf).
SLOS451A revised March 2005, SLOS451B August 2011; Octopart copy is SLOS451A (https://datasheet.octopart.com/THS4631D-Texas-Instruments-datasheet-150388.pdf).
Current layout text: PowerPAD isolated, ground recommended, VS− to VS+ allowed (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ths4631.pdf?ts=1759211980946).
PDN20230907001 (7 Sep 2023) discontinues THS4631D and THS4631DGN with last-time buy (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/5545/PDN20230907001.3.pdf).
